question: Should per-agent dashboard grouping and whole-agent collapse remain a bundled Workspaces-tab follow-up after the Wave 1 dashboard stack, or be folded into the broader multi-agent Control UI roadmap instead?
rationale: Current main lacks the prerequisite dashboard workspace surface, and the request is a new operator UX capability rather than a broken existing contract.

options.title: Keep As Wave 2 Dashboard Item
options.body: Leave this issue open as the specific roadmap child to implement once the dashboard workspace stack has a settled maintainer direction.

options.title: Fold Into Multi-Agent Control UI
options.body: Close or retarget this only if maintainers decide the grouping belongs in the broader orchestration or cross-agent graph issues instead of the dashboard roadmap.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Roadmap
options.body: Pause this item if the Wave 1 dashboard stack is not accepted or the bundled dashboard direction changes materially.

recommendation.title: Keep As Wave 2 Dashboard Item
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the specific roadmap child to implement once the dashboard workspace stack has a settled maintainer direction.
